audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Sign-ins, sessions and API key events, failed agent tool calls, and how each key is used.
audit.noEventsHint: Sign-ins, sessions and API key events appear here. They are kept for 90 days.
audit.noFailedHint: Agent tool calls that failed in the last 7 days appear here.
audit.noKeysHint: Keys that users create on their API keys page appear here.

users.title: Accounts
users.description: Only Discord accounts on this list can sign in. Admins see and manage every project.
users.discordIdHint: In Discord with Developer Mode on: right-click the user, Copy User ID.
users.emptyDescription: Add a Discord user id above so that person can sign in.
users.name: Name
users.removeDescription: They are signed out everywhere and their API keys stop working. Their project memberships stay but grant nothing.

github.title: GitHub App
github.description: Connect a GitHub App so projects can link repositories and follow pull requests, commits and checks.
github.created: GitHub App created. Install it on an account next.
github.requested: Install requested. An owner of the organization has to approve it on GitHub.

errors.state: This GitHub App setup link expired or was started by someone else. Start again.
errors.github: GitHub did not answer as expected. Try again in a moment.
errors.installation: GitHub does not know that installation. Install the app again.
errors.other: Something went wrong with GitHub. Try again.

github.createHint: GitHub registers a private App with read-only access to code, pull requests and checks, then sends you back here.
github.unreachable: GitHub can't reach {origin}. Set BETTER_AUTH_URL to a public URL (for example a tunnel) to create the app here, or use an existing app.
github.connected: GitHub App connected. Install it on an account next.
github.name: Name
github.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the text and copy it by hand.
github.selectedReposCount: {count, plural, one {# selected repo} other {# selected repos}}
github.install: Install on an account or org ↗
github.notInstalledHint: Install the App on a GitHub account or organization to link its repositories.
github.requestedBy: Install requested by {name} on {date}; an organization owner has to approve it on GitHub.
github.permissionsHint: Read-only: metadata, contents, pull requests and checks. Events: pull requests, pushes and check suites.
github.rotateDescription: GitHub switches to the new one right away; deliveries signed with the old one are accepted for 10 minutes.
